BillHeading.BriefDescription: Mitigating disputes between unit owners and unit owners associations under the Washington uniform common interest ownership act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to mitigating disputes between unit owners and unit owners associations under the Washington uniform common interest ownership act; and amending RCW 64.90.685.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 64.90.685 and 2018 c 277 s 418 are each amended to read as follows:Action to enforce right granted, obligation imposed—Court may award reasonable attorneys' fees and costs—Alternative dispute resolution allowed.
BillSection.P: (1) A (a) Subject to (b) of this subsection, a declarant, association, unit owner, or any other person subject to this chapter may bring an action to enforce a right granted or obligation imposed under this chapter or the governing documents. The

P.TextRun: (b) Before bringing an action against an association, a unit owner shall notify the association of the alleged violation. If within 21 days after receiving notice the association fails to cure the violation or provide to the unit owner a substantive response in a tangible medium, the unit owner may bring an action without further notice.

BillSection.P: (2)(a) Except as provided in (b) of this subsection, the court may award reasonable attorneys' fees and costs.

P.TextRun: (b) In an action brought pursuant to this section by a unit owner against an association, the court shall award to a prevailing unit owner the unit owner's actual damages and reasonable attorneys' fees and costs.

BillSection.P: (2) (3) Parties to a dispute arising under this chapter or the governing documents may agree at any time to resolve the dispute by any form of binding or nonbinding alternative dispute resolution.
